summary: Defines the ICMPv6 group of MIB objects, part of the series of IPv6 MIB documents. It lets managers monitor ICMPv6 error and diagnostic messages. It is now historic and was replaced by RFC 4293 and RFC 8096.

eli5.summary: These are counters that count error notes sent on an IPv6 network, so a manager can see how many have gone around.
